newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes little changed against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes little changed against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed little changed at 8.3005 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.3006 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, with market sentiment cautious.
The yuan opened slightly down at 8.3007 and moved in a narrow range of 8.3005 and 8.3008 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.3003 and a low of 8.3010.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3008, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan moved just below the key 8.30-yuan resistance level, with cautious market sentiment.
"The yuan failed to breach the 8.30 resistance level in recent days and buyers seemed to give up their intention of pushing the yuan above that level," said one dealer.
"But it is not likely to fall much due to strong buying around 8.3020," he added. Dealers expect the yuan to remain stable below 8.3000 on Thursday.
The yuan closed down at 7.2758 from 7.2475 against 100 Japanese yen and closed up at an intra-day high of 1.0725 from 1.0727 against the Hong Kong dollar.
